comments.text:
I love the Philippines.  I'm from Canada and ended up marrying a Filipina.  This is fairly accurate, but there are also exceptions.  

I have been alone in a fast food restaurant, and people come up asking me for money.  The store just let this happen.  When I did finally give in, they asked for more because they knew I had more.  All they could say was, "You rich American" 

At the same place, some kid opened the door for me and was very polite.  Didn't ask for anything.  I ended up giving him 20 pesos and complimented him on the way he handled it.  It was clear he wanted money but didn't ask.  Just provided a service.  He was so greatful.  

A lot of times we give food instead of money, and it seems like the majority of people prefer that.  

What is so shocking is how expensive everything is here.  The prices are similar to Canada with everything except for rent.  Very cheap rent in PH.  

When the average person makes about $11 and has to pay the same prices as Canada, it is no wonder there is such rampant poverty.  I truly do not know how some of these people survive.  As a collective, they are amazing people.
